description: Program that copies files, a disk or a whole system image to the owner's own drives. Backup to a provider's servers is in Subscriptions, Memberships & Online Services.
Bundle of small system tools, such as window, file, keyboard and settings utilities, sold as one set rather than as a cleaner.

also_called: antivirus and security suite · internet security

description: Program or hosted tool that stores, generates and fills in passwords and logins. Family, premium and free plans are all included.

Program that allows or blocks a computer's or phone's network connections by application, port or address, sold on its own rather than inside a security suite. A firewall appliance is in Computers & Components.
Program that turns keystrokes into the characters of a language such as Japanese or Chinese, using conversion dictionaries.
Program or hosted tool that makes or changes images from a text or image prompt; making new images and editing existing ones are the same product type.
Program that records the screen or camera and streams it live. Recording and streaming are not split into separate products.
All-apps bundle of one maker's creative programs, sold under its own name rather than after one program. Editions and plans are the same product.
Dictionary, encyclopedia or similar reference work delivered as its own program, or on a disc as a program. As an e-book file it is in Digital Media & Items.
Program for drawing and keeping UML or similar models of software systems, often generating code from them.
Program on the owner's machine that edits, analyses or views geographic data. A hosted map or navigation service is in Subscriptions, Memberships & Online Services.
Program that reads and sends email from a mailbox hosted elsewhere. The mailbox itself is in Subscriptions, Memberships & Online Services.
Program that shares and downloads files over Gnutella, eDonkey and similar networks other than BitTorrent.

also_called: paid feature unlock for built-in device software

description: App that records and shows the readings of one device and does nothing medical.
